title: The self-model is anchored by a persistent internal source of input

statements.text: The center of representational space is linked to localized brain processes, among them the vestibular organ, the spatial matrix of the body schema, visceral self-representation, and upper brainstem nuclei regulating the internal milieu. Their continuous input gives the self-model its invariance, and the self-model differs from all other phenomenal representations by being causally locked to this link.

sources.quote: This source of input is what anchors the human self-model
